business_problem: Ruitai Magang needed to connect disconnected factory systems, equipment, and decision data so it could manage refractory-material production with finer control and support lean manufacturing instead of relying on siloed information.
solution_summary: Ruitai Magang built a transparent-factory platform with Tencent Cloud to connect refractory-material production, operations, and management on top of an industrial internet foundation. The implementation uses a smart-data middle platform to collect lifecycle production data, then combines digital twins, dynamic 3D visualization, AI analysis, IoT integration, and BI to monitor process state across space, time, and equipment status. Tencent's Smart Energy Platform serves as the core coordination layer, while the IoT platform integrates intelligent equipment, multi-level business systems, and the finance ERP system into one data environment. The resulting data flows support intelligent warehousing, automated batching, precision pressing, product lifecycle control, and transparent tracking of logistics, information, and value flows. Instead of leaving plants and systems disconnected, the platform provides a unified view for lean manufacturing and more precise decision-making.

solution_components.name: Tencent IoT Platform

solution_components.name: Digital Twin
solution_components.role: Visualizes the factory and process state in a dynamic 3D environment.

solution_components.name: Business Intelligence

data_flow: Shop-floor, equipment, ERP, and operational data are captured through the IoT and data-middle-platform layers, visualized through digital-twin and BI services, and then used to coordinate warehousing, batching, pressing, lifecycle control, and enterprise operations.
business_outcome: Ruitai Magang gained tighter process control, better visibility across production and operations, and measurable improvements in cost, yield, inventory, and delivery performance.
metrics: The factory receives about 230 visiting groups each year.
